title: Dumbo
about: A baby circus elephant with enormous ears is mocked until he finds out he can fly.
cue: Serve the snacks when Timothy Mouse offers Dumbo a peanut.
faces: Dumbo, the magic feather was just a feather. You had the ears all along. Now eat your peanuts, pal.
One feather, one pair of ears
